content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to connect three [product_name] modules to a single [product_name] HMI panel? What is the method for transferring data from one [product_name] to another? Appreciate any advice.

Based on what I know, a Basic Panel is typically able to connect with up to four controllers. Some more advanced panels may support as many as eight connections. So you should be able to link your three [product_name] modules directly to the HMI panel.
Refer to this example from [company_name]: Master-Master communication. It describes how communication can be set up between two [product_name] modules.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing how to connect multiple [product_name] modules to a single HMI panel and how to facilitate the exchange of data between these modules. The thread highlights questions about the connection limits of the HMI panel and ways to configure inter-module communication.
